newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Cable wins $25 mln deal in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: LG Cable wins $25 mln deal in Thailand.

text.p: South Korea's LG Cable and Machinery has won a $25 million deal from Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand to supply and build an electricity transmission line, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The 230 kilovolt line would connect Nakhon Si Thammarat and Thung Song, he said.
The spokesman said LG Cable, a unit of LG Group, expected to win an additional $15 million deal to supply and construct a 45 kilometre power cable in Ban Pong.
LG Cable will supply and construct optical fibre overhead ground wires, steel towers and accessories on a turn-key basis.
It expects to complete the construction by February 1999.
